notes.text: Band 1 holds lines 0 and 1; only line 0 is a printed head line on the composite, line 1 shows no body text of its own (a speck at the head, or the text layer's split of the head row). Harmless to the zoning.
Centred heading «Варіантъ второй половины сказки.» is band 3 MainZone-Other, as ruled; line 36 opens indented as a paragraph, band 4 MainZone-P. Band 5 holds footnote 1 under the short rule.
